topics.title: 课程作业与考核规范
topics.summary: 未核实全校统一允许使用AI完成作业的许可；具体考核要求由各专业学习委员会及学院章程（如人文学院第9条）明确规定。
topics.scope: 人文学院及各院系共享教学大纲

claims.text: Humanities shared curriculum establishes that permitted generative AI use in written assessments requires an explicit declaration.

evidence.quote:
(2) For exams where use of generative AI is permitted, students must declare if and how the gener-
ative AI has been used. This declaration is considered a part of the programme curriculum’s formal
requirements.
evidence.title: Faculty of Humanities Shared Curriculum 2019 (2025 corrected edition)
evidence.location: PDF page 5, Section 9(2) Formal requirements for exams

topics.title: 考试与考场纪律
topics.summary: 理学院课程规定，学生必须遵守大学有关项目和考试中生成式AI使用的规则与指引，包括强制性AI声明。
topics.scope: 理学院课程：项目与考试
topics.evidenceScope: Faculty of SCIENCE curriculum: projects and examinations

claims.text: The Faculty of SCIENCE curriculum says students must comply with university rules and guidelines on generative AI in projects and exams, including the mandatory AI declaration.

evidence.quote:
Students must at all times comply with the University’s rules and guidelines for the use of
generative AI in projects and exams, including the mandatory AI declaration.
evidence.title: Faculty of SCIENCE Shared Curriculum (September 2026 edition)

topics.title: AI使用声明与披露
topics.summary: 按照人文学科课程规定，在允许使用生成式AI的考试中，学生必须声明是否及如何使用AI；该声明属于课程正式要求。
topics.scope: 人文学科课程：允许使用生成式AI的考试
topics.evidenceScope: Humanities curriculum: exams permitting generative AI

claims.text: For exams where generative AI is permitted, students must declare if and how it was used; the declaration is part of the curriculum’s formal requirements.

evidence.quote:

ative AI has been used. This declaration is considered a part of the programme curriculum’s formal

evidence.title: Faculty of Humanities Shared Curriculum 2019 (2025 corrected edition)
evidence.location: PDF page 5, Section 9(2) Formal requirements for exams
